title: Clue Tracker Answer Key
meta: Use with Clue Tracker Core and Extension

items: Possible predictions: a secret recipe, a surprise competition challenge, or special instructions. This is an inference, not a confirmed fact.
The team arrangement may have changed after the mug was made. Maddie’s crossed-out name suggests she and Zoe may no longer be teammates. Other evidence-based explanations are valid.
Answers will vary. Students should name a possible false lead and explain why it might be misleading or unrelated.
Open response. Students record or sketch additional observations. Look for specific details and clear separation of what was seen from what was inferred.
